canonical_project: Brookhollow Avenue Data Centre Expansion, Norwest
notes: NSW Planning Portal SSD-81928961 for The Hills Shire shows Response to Submissions for construction and operation of an expansion to an existing data centre at 3 Brookhollow Avenue, Norwest. Urban Digest reports a 51,867 sqm site/GFA; Sydney Development Journal reported GreenSquare plans and about 80 MW full build-out capacity.
